definitions.explanation: Short for 生活協同組合 (consumer cooperative association). A membership-based organization where consumers pool resources to purchase goods and services at favorable prices. Very common in Japanese daily life, especially university co-ops and home delivery services.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}の{生協|せいきょう}で{教科書|きょうかしょ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought textbooks at the university co-op.

examples.japanese: {生協|せいきょう}の{宅配|たくはい}サービスを{利用|りよう}している。
examples.english: I use the co-op's home delivery service.

examples.japanese: {生協|せいきょう}に{加入|かにゅう}すると、{食品|しょくひん}や{日用品|にちようひん}を{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}で{購入|こうにゅう}できるほか、{共済|きょうさい}{保険|ほけん}にも{入|はい}れる。
examples.english: By joining the co-op, you can purchase food and daily necessities at discounted prices and also sign up for mutual insurance.

notes:
USAGE:
{生協|せいきょう} is the standard abbreviation for {生活|せいかつ}{協同|きょうどう}{組合|くみあい} (consumer cooperative association). In Japan, co-ops are extremely common — most universities have a co-op ({大学|だいがく}{生協|せいきょう}) that sells textbooks, stationery, and food. Regional co-ops like コープ (CO-OP) offer grocery delivery services that are widely used by families.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大学|だいがく}{生協|せいきょう} (university co-op)
- {生協|せいきょう}の{宅配|たくはい} (co-op delivery)
- {生協|せいきょう}に{加入|かにゅう}する (join a co-op)
- {生協|せいきょう}{食堂|しょくどう} (co-op cafeteria)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {組合|くみあい}: union, cooperative (broader term for any cooperative or labor union)
- コープ: co-op (brand name used by many Japanese consumer cooperatives)
- {協同|きょうどう}{組合|くみあい}: cooperative association (formal, unabbreviated term)
